extra_vocab.en: in a way that shows you truly mean what you say
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於商業書信結尾（Sincerely,），以及 sincerely apologize、sincerely thank 這類客氣、正式的道歉和感謝。語氣誠懇，適合用在郵件與公告。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 信件結尾寫 Sincerely, 時，後面要加逗號，簽名放在下一行；Sincerely 的 S 要大寫。

example.en: We sincerely apologize for the delay in your order.
example.zh: 我們對您的訂單延遲深感抱歉。

example.en: I sincerely thank you for your help with the event.
example.zh: 我由衷感謝您對這場活動的協助。

example.en: We sincerely hope you enjoyed your stay at our hotel.
example.zh: 我們誠摯希望您在本飯店住得愉快。

examples.en: At the end of a formal letter, write Sincerely and your name.
examples.zh: 在正式信件的結尾，寫上 Sincerely 和你的名字。

examples.en: We sincerely invite you to attend our annual dinner on Friday.
examples.zh: 我們誠摯邀請您參加星期五的年度晚宴。

examples.en: I would sincerely like to thank every member of our team.
examples.zh: 我想由衷感謝我們團隊的每一位成員。

confusable.diff: severely 是「嚴重地」，sincerely 是「誠摯地」，兩字拼法和長度很像。

example.en: The storm severely damaged the warehouse roof last night.
example.zh: 昨晚的暴風雨嚴重損壞了倉庫的屋頂。

similar.diff: genuinely 強調真心、不是假裝；sincerely 較正式，常用於信件和道歉。

example.en: We genuinely care about every customer who visits our store.
example.zh: 我們真心關心每一位來店的顧客。

similar.diff: truly 較口語，常放在形容詞前加強語氣（truly sorry）；sincerely 多用在正式場合。

example.en: We are truly sorry for the late reply.
example.zh: 對於遲來的回覆，我們真的很抱歉。

example.en: Honestly, I think the new plan is too expensive.
example.zh: 老實說，我覺得這個新計畫太貴了。

example.en: Please kindly reply to this email before Friday noon.
example.zh: 請在星期五中午前回覆這封電子郵件。

derived.link: sincerely 去掉 -ly 就是形容詞 sincere，像 quick → quickly
sincere + -ity，形容詞變名詞，像 able → ability

extra_vocab.en: at a time that is not known or not decided yet
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於約時間、排行程與寄送文件的情境，用來說一個還沒確定的時間點，如 sometime next week。語氣隨和，不像 by Friday 那麼明確。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: sometime 是副詞，後面直接接時間（sometime next week），前面不加介系詞 on 或 at。

example.en: Let's meet sometime next week to review the budget.
example.zh: 我們下週找個時間見面，檢視一下預算吧。

example.en: The new store will open sometime in March.
example.zh: 新店會在三月的某個時候開幕。

example.en: Please come to visit our new office sometime soon.
example.zh: 歡迎近期來參觀我們的新辦公室。

examples.en: I will send you the final report sometime tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我明天早上的某個時候會把最終報告寄給你。

examples.en: Can we have lunch sometime and talk about the plan?
examples.zh: 我們找個時間一起吃午餐，聊聊這個計畫好嗎？

examples.en: I plan to visit your Taipei office sometime this fall.
examples.zh: 我打算今年秋天找個時間去拜訪你們的台北辦公室。

confusable.diff: sometimes 是「有時候」，說明發生的頻率；sometime 是「某個時候」，指一個未定的時間點。

example.en: The train is sometimes late on Monday mornings.
example.zh: 這班火車在星期一早上有時候會誤點。

confusable.diff: some time 是「一段時間」，sometime 是「某個時間點」。
confusable.usage: some time 是兩個字，some 是限定詞、time 是名詞，指一段時間；sometime 是副詞，指某個時間點。

example.en: It will take some time to repair the printer.
example.zh: 修理印表機需要一段時間。

similar.diff: at some point 也是「在某個時候」，語氣稍正式，常放在句尾或句首。

example.en: We will update the website at some point next month.
example.zh: 我們下個月會在某個時間點更新網站。

example.en: I will call you later this afternoon to confirm.
example.zh: 我今天下午稍晚會打電話跟你確認。

example.en: The company eventually moved its office to a bigger building.
example.zh: 公司最後把辦公室搬到一棟更大的建築。

extra_vocab.en: a person who watches and directs the work of other workers
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於職場、請假、回報與人事情境，指直接管理員工日常工作的主管，通常比 manager 更貼近第一線。

example.en: All supervisors must attend the safety training on Monday.
example.zh: 所有主管都必須參加星期一的安全訓練。

example.en: Please report to a supervisor if you find any problem.
example.zh: 如果發現任何問題，請向主管回報。

example.en: The shift supervisor will assign tasks to each worker.
example.zh: 輪班主管會把工作分配給每位員工。

example.en: Ask your immediate supervisor to approve the leave request.
example.zh: 請你的直屬主管核准這份請假申請。

examples.en: My supervisor approved my vacation request this morning.
examples.zh: 我的主管今天早上核准了我的休假申請。

examples.en: Your supervisor will review your work after three months.
examples.zh: 你的主管會在三個月後檢視你的工作表現。

examples.en: I have copied my supervisor on this email for reference.
examples.zh: 我已把我的主管列為這封電子郵件的副本收件人供參考。

examples.en: A supervisor checks every product before it leaves the line.
examples.zh: 主管在每件產品離開生產線前都會檢查。

confusable.diff: advisor 是提供意見的顧問，沒有直接管理員工的權力；supervisor 是管理員工的主管。

example.en: Our financial advisor suggested a new savings plan.
example.zh: 我們的財務顧問建議了一個新的儲蓄計畫。

similar.diff: manager 負責管理部門、預算或專案；supervisor 偏重直接監督員工的日常工作。

example.en: The manager approved the budget for the new project.
example.zh: 經理核准了這個新專案的預算。

similar.diff: boss 是口語說法，泛指老闆或上司；supervisor 較正式，適合用在信件和公告。

example.en: My boss wants the report on his desk today.
example.zh: 我的上司希望今天就把報告放在他桌上。

example.en: Every new employee receives a welcome packet on the first day.
example.zh: 每位新員工在第一天都會收到一份歡迎資料袋。

example.en: The director will give a short speech at the meeting.
example.zh: 總監會在會議上做一段簡短的演說。

derived.link: supervisor 去掉 -or 就是動詞 supervise，像 visit → visitor
supervise + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 decide → decision

extra_vocab.en: a meeting where a group learns about or talks about a topic
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司培訓、專業講座與報名通知的情境，規模比 conference 小，重點在學習與討論。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: attend 是及物動詞，直接接 seminar（attend the seminar），不加 to。

example.en: The firm holds seminars on tax rules every spring.
example.zh: 這家公司每年春天都舉辦關於稅務規定的研討會。

example.en: All new staff must attend a seminar on safety rules.
example.zh: 所有新進員工都必須參加安全規定的講習。

example.en: We will hold a seminar on online marketing in May.
example.zh: 我們五月會舉辦一場網路行銷的研討會。

example.en: Please register for the seminar by this Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 請在本週五下午前報名這場研討會。

examples.en: The seminar starts at nine and ends at noon.
examples.zh: 研討會九點開始，中午結束。

examples.en: You are invited to our free seminar on financial planning.
examples.zh: 誠摯邀請您參加我們免費的理財規劃研討會。

examples.en: Thank you for speaking at yesterday's seminar. It was very helpful.
examples.zh: 謝謝您在昨天的研討會上演講，內容非常有幫助。

confusable.diff: semester 是學校的學期；seminar 是研討會，兩字拼法相近。

example.en: Tuition for the next semester must be paid by May.
example.zh: 下一學期的學費必須在五月前繳清。

similar.diff: workshop 強調動手練習與參與；seminar 以講解和討論為主。

example.en: The workshop gives each person time to practice new skills.
example.zh: 這個工作坊讓每個人都有時間練習新技能。

similar.diff: conference 是規模較大的會議，常有多場演講；seminar 規模較小。

example.en: The annual conference attracts over two thousand visitors every year.
example.zh: 這場年度大會每年吸引超過兩千名訪客。

example.en: The professor will give a lecture on global trade.
example.zh: 教授將發表一場關於全球貿易的演講。

example.en: The morning session will cover customer service skills.
example.zh: 早上的課程會涵蓋客戶服務技巧。

extra_vocab.en: a train system that runs under the ground in a city
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於通勤、旅遊交通與地址指引的情境。subway 是美式說法，英式多用 underground 或 tube。

example.en: Many large cities have subways that run until midnight.
example.zh: 許多大城市的地鐵運行到午夜。

example.en: The office is a short walk from the subway station.
example.zh: 辦公室離地鐵站只有一小段步行距離。

example.en: The new subway line will open in the spring.
example.zh: 新的地鐵路線將在春天通車。

example.en: Most employees take the subway to work every day.
example.zh: 大多數員工每天搭地鐵上班。

example.en: Check the subway map before you leave the hotel.
example.zh: 離開飯店前，請先看一下地鐵路線圖。

examples.en: The subway is faster than the bus during rush hour.
examples.zh: 尖峰時段搭地鐵比搭公車快。

examples.en: Visitors can buy a subway ticket at the airport.
examples.zh: 旅客可以在機場購買地鐵車票。

examples.en: Subway service will stop early on Sunday night for repairs.
examples.zh: 星期日晚上地鐵會因維修而提早停駛。

similar.diff: underground 是英式說法，指倫敦等城市的地鐵；美式多用 subway。

example.en: We took the underground to our meeting in London.
example.zh: 我們搭地鐵去倫敦參加會議。

similar.diff: metro 是歐洲和許多城市對地鐵的稱呼，常出現在地鐵系統的名稱中。

example.en: The metro runs every five minutes during the day.
example.zh: 地鐵白天每五分鐘一班。

example.en: Our hotel is next to the main train station.
example.zh: 我們的飯店就在火車總站旁邊。

example.en: You can transfer to the red line at Central Station.
example.zh: 你可以在中央車站轉乘紅線。

senses.en: an underground train system in a city

example.en: I ride the subway to the downtown office every morning.
example.zh: 我每天早上搭地鐵到市中心的辦公室。

senses.en: a path under a road for people to walk through
senses.distinguish: 在英國，subway 常指讓行人穿過馬路的地下通道；看到 use the subway to cross the road 就是這個意思。

example.en: Pedestrians should use the subway to cross the busy road.
example.zh: 行人應該利用地下通道穿越繁忙的馬路。

extra_vocab.en: a large bag with a handle that you use to carry clothes when you travel
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於出差、機場、飯店與行李規定的情境，指裝衣物的行李箱。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: suitcase 是可數名詞（one suitcase, two suitcases）；行李的總稱 luggage、baggage 是不可數，不能說 a luggage。

example.en: Each passenger may bring two suitcases on this flight.
example.zh: 每位乘客在這個航班可以攜帶兩個行李箱。

example.en: Please pack your suitcase the night before the trip.
example.zh: 請在出發前一晚把行李箱打包好。

example.en: She had to carry a heavy suitcase up the stairs.
example.zh: 她必須提著一個沉重的行李箱爬樓梯。

example.en: The airline found my lost suitcase this morning.
example.zh: 航空公司今天早上找到了我遺失的行李箱。

examples.en: Please place your suitcase on the scale at the check-in counter.
examples.zh: 請把您的行李箱放在報到櫃檯的磅秤上。

examples.en: A staff member will bring your suitcase to your room.
examples.zh: 服務人員會把您的行李箱送到房間。

examples.en: This suitcase is light, strong, and easy to carry on trips.
examples.zh: 這個行李箱輕、堅固，旅行時很容易攜帶。

confusable.diff: briefcase 是裝文件和筆電的公事包；suitcase 是裝衣物的行李箱。

example.en: He carried a briefcase with the contract inside.
example.zh: 他提著一個裝有合約的公事包。

similar.diff: luggage 是行李的總稱，不可數；suitcase 是其中一個可數的箱子。

example.en: Please keep your luggage with you at all times.
example.zh: 請隨時把您的行李帶在身邊。

example.en: Baggage claim is on the first floor near gate three.
example.zh: 行李提領處在一樓，靠近三號登機口。

example.en: Each passenger must show a passport at the gate.
example.zh: 每位乘客都必須在登機口出示護照。

extra_vocab.en: a large store where people buy food and things for the home
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於購物、促銷廣告、供應商與零售業的情境，指賣食品和日用品的大型商店。

example.en: Supermarkets order fresh fruit from local farms every day.
example.zh: 超市每天向當地農場訂購新鮮水果。

example.en: The local supermarket opens at seven every morning.
example.zh: 當地的超市每天早上七點開門。

example.en: The supermarket chain plans to open ten new stores.
example.zh: 這家連鎖超市計畫開設十間新店。

example.en: Our new juice will be on supermarket shelves next month.
example.zh: 我們的新果汁下個月就會上超市貨架。

examples.en: Our supermarket offers free delivery on orders over fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 本超市對滿五十美元的訂單提供免費送貨。

examples.en: I stopped at the supermarket to buy coffee for the office.
examples.zh: 我順道去超市買了給辦公室的咖啡。

examples.en: The supermarket is hiring more cashiers for the holiday season.
examples.zh: 這家超市為了假期旺季正在招募更多收銀員。

confusable.diff: market 可指市集或市場；supermarket 是室內的大型連鎖商店。

example.en: The farmers' market sells fresh vegetables on Saturdays.
example.zh: 農夫市集在星期六販售新鮮蔬菜。

similar.diff: grocery store 規模較小、較口語；supermarket 商品種類更多。

example.en: The small grocery store near my office closes at nine.
example.zh: 我辦公室附近的小雜貨店九點關門。

example.en: I bought the groceries for the party after work.
example.zh: 我下班後買了派對要用的食品雜貨。

example.en: The cashier gave me a receipt and my change.
example.zh: 收銀員給了我收據和找零。

example.en: You can find the coffee in aisle number five.
example.zh: 你可以在第五條走道找到咖啡。

derived.link: super（超級、很大）+ market（市場），大型的市場，也就是超市

extra_vocab.en: two pieces of bread with food such as meat or cheese between them
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於午餐、會議餐點、咖啡店菜單與外送的情境，是最常見的輕食之一。

example.en: The café sells sandwiches and salads from eleven to three.
example.zh: 這家咖啡店從十一點到三點販售三明治和沙拉。

example.en: Can I order a sandwich and a small coffee?
example.zh: 我可以點一個三明治和一杯小杯咖啡嗎？

example.en: There is a sandwich shop on the first floor.
example.zh: 一樓有一家三明治店。

example.en: A chicken sandwich is the most popular item on the menu.
example.zh: 雞肉三明治是菜單上最受歡迎的品項。

examples.en: We ordered sandwiches for everyone attending the lunch meeting.
examples.zh: 我們為所有參加午餐會議的人訂了三明治。

examples.en: Each sandwich comes with a drink and a small salad.
examples.zh: 每個三明治都附一杯飲料和一份小沙拉。

examples.en: I will pick up a sandwich on my way to the office.
examples.zh: 我會在去辦公室的路上買一個三明治。

similar.diff: wrap 是用薄餅捲起食材；sandwich 是用兩片麵包夾住食材。

example.en: The café also sells vegetable wraps for lunch.
example.zh: 這家咖啡店午餐也有賣蔬菜捲餅。

example.en: The lunch set includes a sandwich and a green salad.
example.zh: 午餐套餐包含一個三明治和一份蔬菜沙拉。

example.en: The bakery makes fresh bread every morning at five.
example.zh: 這家麵包店每天早上五點製作新鮮麵包。
